messages:
oliver: hi team, first day. followed onboarding doc but Buildkite jobs immediately error with webhook/pipeline issues while GH Actions looks fine. any quick triage steps?

nina: welcome! paste the Buildkite error and say whether you're on a company VM or laptop.

oliver: company VM. build log: 
```
2026-03-26T09:12:02Z ERROR webhook: failed to create check run: 403 Forbidden
message: installation not found for user or org
```

raj: that means the Redwood CI GitHub App doesn't have installation for that repo/org. Common during onboarding if you install to your personal account.

oliver: i used the install link in the doc. where do i check?

nina: GitHub -> Organization Settings -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI -> Configure. Either set to "All repositories" or add the specific repo. Also make sure Checks & Deployments permissions are granted.

ci-bot: Warning: Buildkite build #78 failed: job 'ci:integration' exited 1. Logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding/78/jobs/4

oliver: i don't have org admin. raj, can infra add the repo?

raj: sure, raising a request. infra-bot will post when done.

infra-bot: Action: @raj requested to add repo access for 'infra/onboard-sandbox' to 'Redwood CI'. Approvers: @nina, @mel.

nina: approved. Adding repo now. After that you may need to re-run the pipeline webhook registration in pipeline settings.

oliver: repo added. re-triggering build...

ci-bot: Buildkite build #79 started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding/79

oliver: new error from agent: 
```
ERR: buildkite-agent: could not accept job: unknown pipeline: onboard-sandbox
status: 404
```

raj: that usually means the agent token isn't valid for the team/pipeline. If you used an onboarding DM token it might've been rotated. On the VM run `sudo cat /etc/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.cfg` and confirm token, or create a new token: Buildkite -> Teams -> Agents -> New token (scope: agent). Replace token and `sudo systemctl restart buildkite-agent`.

oliver: token was from my onboarding DM. regenerated a token and restarted agent. retriggering build...

ci-bot: Buildkite build #80 started and running.

oliver: build picked up and tests are running. thanks! quick q: who do i ping if tokens or app installs break later?

nina: ping #eng-infra and tag @raj. infra-bot will auto-file a ticket if webhook/install changes. also we have a short onboarding note about token rotation, feel free to PR a 'reuse VM' tip.

raj: adding you to the agent rotation doc now. welcome aboard! :wave:
